    Please read before ordering

    Pashabakess is not allergen-free, nut-free, gluten-free, or dairy-free. Everything is prepared in the same kitchen using shared equipment, trays, utensils, and packaging areas. Because cross-contact can happen, I do not recommend ordering or sharing the cookies with anyone with food allergies.

    Returns & cancellations

    Due to the nature of these treats, they cannot be returned or exchanged. If you need to cancel an order, give 2 days notice by emailing me.

    pashabakess@gmail.com

    You’ll get a receipt by email right away. Once Pasha sees your payment, she confirms your order and emails you the pickup address.
